## Walkthrough A new helper function `getKindPreferredVersion` was added to discover the correct API version for a specific Kubernetes resource kind by querying the API server's discovery interface. The infrastructure reference resolution logic was updated to use kind-specific version discovery instead of API-group-wide assumptions, addressing incorrect version assumptions when providers support different versions for different kinds. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Version Discovery Logic**
`cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_controller.go`|Added new helper function `getKindPreferredVersion` that queries API server ServerGroups to find the preferred version for a specific kind within an API group. Iterates through group versions and returns the first match, with error handling for missing groups, failed discovery, or kinds not found.| |**Version Discovery Tests**
`cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_controller_test.go`|Added comprehensive unit test `TestGetKindPreferredVersion` covering scenarios: kind exists in one version, exists in multiple versions (returns first), kind absent (error), and missing API group (error).| |**Test Framework Updates**
`cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_test_framework.go`|Updated fake discovery configuration to explicitly specify `Kind: machineTemplateKind` for the machinetemplates APIResource entry in the infrastructure API group.| |**Production Code Integration**
`cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_unstructured.go`|Modified `readInfrastructureReferenceResource` to extract kind early, then call `getKindPreferredVersion` with both API group and kind parameters for accurate version discovery instead of assuming version based on API group alone.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes

no unrelated modifications detected. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | Test uses standard Go testing package with t.Run() and static, descriptive test case names with no dynamic values. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR does not add Ginkgo e2e tests, only a standard Go unit test in clusterapi_controller_test.go using testing.T pattern. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Pull request adds only a standard Go unit test that does not interact with cluster topology or make multi-node assumptions. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Pull request contains only API version discovery utility functions with no scheduling constraints or deployment manifests impacting topology compatibility. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The OTE Binary Stdout Contract check is not applicable to this PR, which modifies cluster-autoscaler cloudprovider clusterapi utility library code and unit tests, not OTE test binaries. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR does not add Ginkgo e2e tests; 🧹 Nitpick comments (1)
cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_controller.go (1)
`627-635`: **Prioritize `PreferredVersion` when selecting API versions.** On Line 627, the version choice depends on the order of `group.Versions`, which is not guaranteed by the Kubernetes API specification. Instead, check `PreferredVersion` first, then fall back to remaining versions.
💡 Proposed refactor ```diff func getKindPreferredVersion(client discovery.DiscoveryInterface, apiGroup, kind string) (string, error) { @@ for _, group := range groupList.Groups { if group.Name != apiGroup { continue } - for _, v := range group.Versions { + orderedVersions := make([]metav1.GroupVersionForDiscovery, 0, len(group.Versions)) + if group.PreferredVersion.GroupVersion != "" { + orderedVersions = append(orderedVersions, group.PreferredVersion) + } + for _, v := range group.Versions { + if v.GroupVersion == group.PreferredVersion.GroupVersion { + continue + } + orderedVersions = append(orderedVersions, v) + } + for _, v := range orderedVersions { resourceList, err := client.ServerResourcesForGroupVersion(v.GroupVersion) if err != nil { return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get resources for %s: %v", v.GroupVersion, err) } for _, r := range resourceList.APIResources { if r.Kind == kind { return v.Version, nil } } } return "", fmt.Errorf("kind %q not found in any version of group %q", kind, apiGroup) } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. In `@cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_controller.go` around lines 627 - 635, The version selection currently iterates group.Versions in arbitrary order; update the logic in the function that queries client.ServerResourcesForGroupVersion to first check group.PreferredVersion (if non-empty) for the desired kind, and if that returns the matching APIResource (compare r.Kind == kind), return that version; if PreferredVersion does not contain the kind, then fall back to iterating group.Versions as before to find a matching r.Kind. Ensure you use v.GroupVersion when calling ServerResourcesForGroupVersion and keep the existing error handling. ```
